title.en: A new ruler for the ocean is ready for its handoff
title.zh: 海洋的新标尺，准备怎样接棒？

summary.en: Sentinel-6B has completed calibration and initial checks for a planned reference role, preserving a long ocean record.
summary.zh: Sentinel-6B完成校准与初步检查，为计划中的基准任务准备接棒，延续长期海洋记录。

title.en: Ice remains on Puncak Jaya. Its glaciers have stopped moving.
title.zh: 查亚峰仍有残冰，冰川的流动却已停下

summary.en: NASA describes a tropical ice system’s functional end while remnant patches and uncertain disappearance timelines remain.
summary.zh: NASA描述热带冰川系统的功能终结；残冰仍在，完全消失的时间仍有不确定性。
